output.meaning: Select a currently listed Sway output by its connector name or uniquely identifying make/model/serial key. The stored selection cannot contain a newline or carriage return. Not supported without Sway.

resolution.meaning: On Sway, use auto or a string WxH with positive decimal dimensions (no leading zero, each at most 65535). Non-automatic dimensions must match an eligible advertised mode. Without Sway the Hyprland path stringifies non-object input and passes it to hyprctl.

refresh_rate.meaning: On Sway, request positive finite Hz as a number for the current mode dimensions, using advertised timings. Without Sway the Hyprland path stringifies non-object input and passes it to hyprctl.

scale.meaning: On Sway, use auto or the numbers 1 or 2 (not boolean); auto removes the override and applies scale 1. Without Sway the Hyprland path stringifies non-object input and has no local numeric bound.

orientation.meaning: On Sway, use auto, normal, 90, 180 or 270 (strings). Hyprland accepts normal, 90, 180, 270, flipped, flipped90, flipped180, flipped270, flipped-90/-180/-270 and transforms 0–7 after string conversion, trimming, lowercasing and removing degree signs.

payload.meaning: Supply exactly one of the five fields; none is individually required. Use the dedicated hdr/set and adaptive-sync/set stops for those features.

changed.meaning: The stop reports whether an effect or stored change was observed on this path.

receiptPath.meaning: Optional legacy receipt-file path from older staff; absent when staff writes no receipt file.

receipt.meaning: Native settings receipt metadata: ok, changed, kind, fields, backups and commands; entries describe files and command outcomes.

backups.meaning: Original file metadata for files backed up by the act.

commands.meaning: Arguments and return codes for the dispatched tools.

mutationPerformed.meaning: Whether the stop reports acting; this is not an assertion that every effect completed.

values.meaning: Display policy fallback values on a structured Sway failure.

settingsSource.meaning: Source of those display policy values, when included.

backend.meaning: Selected compositor coordinates on a structured refusal.

exceptionType.meaning: Exception class when an unexpected fault is reported by the front door instead of the stop.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Absent when the stop emits no signal. The enum lists literal outcomes. An extra key is reported as unknown-field:<key>. Command setup faults can report command-unavailable:<exception class>. Failed compensation can prefix the original diagnostic with rollback-failed:, live-rollback-failed: or position-rollback-failed:, including the rollback diagnostic. Filesystem and malformed compositor reply errors can pass through as exception text. The envelope reader also reports the missing kernel keys by name.
enum: refresh_rate must be a positive finite number
resolution must be auto or positive WxH
